brainlife.desc: FreeSurfer recon-all subject directory (mri, surf, label, stats, scripts): surfaces, segmentations, parcellations and statistics.
brainlife.name: neuro/freesurfer

original.desc: Folder structure generated by FreeSurfer recon-all process.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Source of cortical surfaces, parcellations and morphometry for downstream Apps. MEG/EEG source modelling and coregistration (BEM, source spaces).

**Not for:** Sharing as-is: mri/ holds the input whole-head T1w (rawavg.mgz, orig.mgz, T1.mgz). Mixing outputs of different FreeSurfer versions in one analysis.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 115 Apps, output of 8 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.freesurfer.json
